payload.title: [server] CORS missing on composed router + /auth/logout ignores bearer header
payload.description: Found in the PR #8 Codex review. (1) The Rust server parsed FRICK_ALLOWED_ORIGINS but never applied CORS/preflight middleware, so cross-origin browser calls (web client :5173 -> server :4099) failed. Added crates/frick-server/src/cors.rs (tower-http CorsLayer mirroring the TS setCors/handlePreflight contract) applied in boot::listen. (2) /auth/logout only read sessionToken from the JSON body; now reads Authorization: Bearer / x-frick-session-token via extract::session_token_from_headers, body optional. Regression-guarded by crates/frick-server/tests/cors_and_logout.rs. Commit e673406.
